_about: Fatewell house overlay. Facts from the Lania ledger (canon or draft as marked); invented details marked new.

Library.add: Account books for the fen catch share the shelves with Fearnyard scripture.

Trophy room.add: Turtle shells and stuffed marsh fowl crowd the walls.

things.name: account book
things.description: A heavy book of the household's dealings in smoked eel, turtle and fowl.
things.text: Columns of catches bought from the fen trappers, and carts sent to Wolfront market. The last pages are in a different hand.

things.name: Swangel Fatewell
things.here: Swangel Fatewell sits at the library table.
things.description: The widow who heads the household and the smokehouses, hunt-master of Bayfshear.
things.talk: Swangel looks up from her accounts. "You came through the fen, not past the posts. I haven't decided what to do about that."

things.name: hired trapper
things.here: A hired trapper is mending snares on a cot.
things.description: A wiry trapper the household hires for the fen lines.
